description: This file defines a custom guardrail class 'AporiaGuardrail' for integrating AporiaAI with a system that uses guardrails for moderation and validation of language model responses. It includes methods for message transformation, API request preparation, making API calls, and hooks for post-call and during-call moderation.

classes.name: AporiaGuardrail
classes.description: A custom guardrail class for integrating AporiaAI with guardrail-based moderation, including message transformation, API request handling, and moderation hooks.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the AporiaGuardrail with optional API key and base URL, sets up HTTP client.

methods.name: transform_messages
methods.description: Transforms message list to ensure roles are supported, defaulting unsupported roles to 'other'.

methods.name: prepare_aporia_request
methods.description: Prepares the request payload for AporiaAI API, setting validation target based on presence of messages and response string.

methods.name: make_aporia_api_request
methods.description: Sends a request to the AporiaAI API with the prepared data, handles 'block' action by raising HTTPException.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook
methods.description: Post-call hook to send moderation data to AporiaAI after a successful call.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook
methods.description: During-call moderation hook that transforms messages and sends data to AporiaAI for moderation.
